name: cambio
description: Crypto swap quotes compared across exchanges, help for a wallet with no coin for network fees, and Cambio swap tracking.

interface.longDescription: Cambio is an instant crypto exchange. Ask for a quote and see what you would receive for your exact amount, compared with other exchanges. Stuck with tokens and no coin for the network fee, like USDT on Tron with no TRX? Get the fee coin and the fix. Track a Cambio swap from deposit to payout with its order number and receiving address. The plugin only shows information: swaps are created by you on cambio.one or in the Cambio Telegram bot, from the card's buttons.
defaultPrompt: Swap 1000 USDT on Arbitrum to USDT on BSC
